## Motivation

Add AFD support to sglang-simulator for evaluating Attention–FFN disaggregation on CPU, using AIC costs and virtual events while retaining the existing Scheduler and HTTP request lifecycle.

Depends on the AFD implementation in #41646; related discussion: #41648. Use the latest implementation checkout. Compatibility is maintained through interface checks and regression tests rather than source hash locks.

## Modifications

- Keep simulator source code separate from the native AFD implementation. Reuse native control flow at runtime through thin adapters.
- Decouple execution adapters, virtual-event scheduling and cost interfaces so they can evolve independently.
- Model computation, communication, dependencies and resource contention as virtual events.
- Integrate per-request completion times with the Simulator Scheduler.
- Support native-style A/F role configuration and both legacy and compiled-core AIC APIs.
- Provide setup commands, public-AIC reproduction and examples in `tools/sglang-simulator/AFD.md`.

## Accuracy Tests

This PR simulates execution timing; it does not validate numerical model outputs.

- Nine focused CPU tests pass, covering both routing adapters, event scheduling and Scheduler integration.
- Both routing CLIs run successfully. Four public-AIC cases reproduce previous results exactly, with matching CLI and Python API outputs.
- Previously validated synthetic HTTP case: 16 requests and 48 output tokens completed through one prefill and two decode iterations.

Conditional SM103 timing comparison: Qwen3-235B, Direct 8A8F/S2, TRTLLM + NCCL Direct + DeepGEMM.

| Cost database | Cases | Throughput MAPE |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Expanded AIC | 4 | 6.79% |
| Public AIC | 4 | 21.39% |

Expanded AIC includes supplementary operator measurements and interpolation. Uncovered components use explicit formulas. No scale or offset was fitted.

These are fixed-step comparisons with partially matched execution conditions, not full HTTP performance validation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

| Execution | Observed time |
| :--- | ---: |
| Simulator fixed-step CLI | 1.29–6.69 seconds per case |
| Service benchmark: two warmups and one formal run, service ready | 2.3–9.4 minutes per case |

The execution scopes differ, so these times do not establish an end-to-end speedup. Production inference execution is unchanged.

- [ ] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add focused unit tests.
- [x] Update documentation and reproduction commands.
- [x] Provide timing accuracy comparisons and execution-time measurements.
- [ ] Complete the SGLang code-style review.

+# AFD simulation
+
+## Motivation
+
+Simulate Attention–FFN disaggregation (AFD) on CPU: execute selected native
+control bodies as costed virtual events, then return completion times to the
+ordinary Simulator Scheduler and benchmark.
+
+AFD implementation: [PR #41646](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41646)
+· [issue #41648](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/41648).
+
+## Specification
+
+| Item | Current support |
+| :--- | :--- |
+| Model | Qwen3-235B-A22B: 94 layers, H4096, Q64/KV4/D128, 128 experts, top-k8 |
+| Compute | TRTLLM attention with FP8 Q/KV, page64; none A2A and DeepGEMM, compact unmasked layout, block128 UE8M0 |
+| F-side routing | 8A + 2/4/8F, two equal stages; route on F after gathering inputs |
+| Direct routing | 8A8F, two equal stages; A Router/TopK, broadcast to every F, local expert/combine on F, sum partials on A |
+| Request workload | OFFLINE, uniform KV, fixed cohorts, batch divisible by 16, synchronous iterations |
+| Costs | Complete decode JSON catalog keyed by batch/effective KV; explicit whole-batch prefill costs |
+| Sources | Latest trusted AFD implementation checkout; required files and interfaces are checked |
+| Outputs | Request/iteration/metrics files, event traces, critical path and cost provenance |
+
+Use `--afd-execution-mode attention|ffn` and `--afd-config` with
+`ffn_backend=fixed|direct`. Missing costs or incompatible sources fail explicitly.
+
+| Boundary | Status |
+| :--- | :--- |
+| Cost catalog | Prepared exact/interpolated/formula records; no live AIC lookup in the runner |
+| Unsupported | Auto negotiation, unequal KV, request migration, cross-iteration overlap |
+| Not validated | Capacity admission, numerical model output, full HTTP performance accuracy |
+| New models/backends | Require matching execution and cost adapters |
+
+## How it works
+
+```mermaid
+sequenceDiagram
+    participant B as Ordinary benchmark
+    participant A as A HTTP service and Scheduler
+    participant F as Internal F CPU task service
+    participant E as Virtual A/F events and cost catalog
+    F->>F: Verify sources and costs
+    A->>F: Validate configuration
+    B->>A: Requests
+    A->>A: Select batch and manage KV
+    A->>F: Request IDs, phase and actual lengths
+    F->>E: Execute native control bodies with cost hooks
+    E-->>F: Step end and per-request completion offsets
+    F-->>A: Completion times and provenance
+    A->>A: Advance logical clock and request state
+    A-->>B: Responses and metrics
+```
+
+A keeps the real Scheduler and KV lifecycle; F runs all virtual A/F ranks in
+one event graph. Each request receives its sampling completion offset; the next
+iteration waits for the full step. Device costs count, CPU/RPC wall time does not.
+Prefill uses an explicit whole-batch cost. Generic scheduling/cost contracts stay
+separate from source-checked SGLang adapters; temporary hooks are restored on exit.
+
+## Prepare and reproduce
+
+Run from the repository root in a Linux CPU Simulator environment:
+`python3 -m pip install -e tools/sglang-simulator`. Model metadata and the bundled
+tokenizer suffice for the control demo.
+
+**1. Prepare the AFD implementation checkout.** `SOURCE` is its repository root
+(containing `python/sglang/srt/afd/`), separate from Simulator and AIC. For an
+experimental rebase:
+
+```bash
+export SIMULATOR="$PWD"
+export SOURCE="$(dirname "$PWD")/sglang-afd-experiment"
+(
+  set -e
+  git fetch https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git \
+    +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/afd-demo/main \
+    +refs/pull/41646/head:refs/remotes/afd-demo/implementation
+  git worktree add -b codex/afd-sim-experiment "$SOURCE" \
+    refs/remotes/afd-demo/implementation
+  git -C "$SOURCE" rebase refs/remotes/afd-demo/main
+)
+```
+
+Conflicts stop in `$SOURCE`; inspect or run `git -C "$SOURCE" rebase --abort`.
+Run the source tests after updating the AFD checkout.
+
+**2. Prepare the HTTP control fixture.** Use a new `CASE`; repeat the environment
+settings in each terminal. Generated 10 ns costs are synthetic.
+
+```bash
+: "${SOURCE:?Set SOURCE to the AFD implementation worktree created above}"
+export CASE="$PWD/experiments/afd-http"
+python3 tools/sglang-simulator/scripts/configure_experiment.py \
+  --simulator-root "$PWD" --source-root "$SOURCE" --routing direct \
+  --output "$CASE-env" && \
+python3 tools/sglang-simulator/examples/afd_serving/make_control_fixture.py \
+  --source-root "$SOURCE" --output "$CASE"
+source "$CASE-env/env.sh"
+export AFD_CONFIG="$(cat "$CASE/native.json")"
+export SGLANG_USE_CPU_ENGINE=1
+export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2
+export SGLANG_SIMULATOR_OUTPUT_MODE=OFFLINE
+export SGLANG_SIMULATOR_OUTPUT_DIR="$CASE/a-results"
+```
+
+`configure_experiment.py` checks existing source files and writes `env.sh`;
+it does not install dependencies or execute a model.
+
+**Terminal F — start the internal task service:**
+
+```bash
+python3 -m sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.launch_server \
+  --afd-execution-mode ffn --afd-config "$AFD_CONFIG" \
+  --sim-config-path "$CASE/simulation.json"
+```
+
+**Terminal A — after F is ready, start the HTTP service:**
+
+```bash
+python3 -m sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang.launch_server \
+  --afd-execution-mode attention --afd-config "$AFD_CONFIG" \
+  --sim-config-path "$CASE/simulation.json" --model-path "$CASE/model" \
+  --tokenizer-path tools/sglang-simulator/examples/assets/tokenizer \
+  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 --context-length 128 \
+  --max-total-tokens 256 --max-running-requests 16 \
+  --chunked-prefill-size -1 --disable-radix-cache --disable-overlap-schedule
+```
+
+**Terminal benchmark — submit the fixed cohort:**
+
+```bash
+python3 benchmark/simulator/bench_serving.py \
+  --simulator-mode offline --backend sglang --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000 \
+  --model "$CASE/model" --tokenizer tools/sglang-simulator/examples/assets/tokenizer \
+  --dataset-name random-ids --tokenize-prompt \
+  --random-input-len 4 --random-output-len 3 --random-range-ratio 1 \
+  --num-prompts 16 --max-concurrency 16 --request-rate inf \
+  --warmup-requests 0 --profile --output-file "$CASE/benchmark.json"
+```
+
+Read logical request metrics from `a-results/{request.jsonl,iteration.jsonl,metrics.json}`
+and events from `f-events/step-*.json`. `--profile` enables Simulator statistics;
+HTTP wall time is not device time. F is loopback-only, with one A client. Stop
+both services afterward. Fixed-step diagnostics: `python3 -m sglang_simulator.afd.cli --help`.
+
+Run the focused checks with both source profiles configured:
+
+```bash
+export SGLANG_SIMULATOR_SOURCE_ROOT="$SOURCE"
+export SGLANG_SIMULATOR_DIRECT_SOURCE_ROOT="$SOURCE"
+PYTHONPATH=tools/sglang-simulator/src python3 -B -m unittest discover \
+  -s tools/sglang-simulator/test -p 'test_afd.py'
+PYTHONPATH=tools/sglang-simulator/src python3 -B -m unittest discover \
+  -s tools/sglang-simulator/test -p 'test_simulation_afd_bridge.py'
+```
+
+Source tests skip without their environment variables and fail on missing interfaces;
+the Scheduler test needs the ordinary predictor dependencies.
+
+**3. Reproduce public AIC predictions.** Use Python 3.11–3.13 and a compatible Rust
+toolchain. Reuse `$SOURCE`; choose new checkout/output paths:
+
+```bash
+(
+  set -e
+  : "${SOURCE:?Set SOURCE to the AFD implementation worktree created above}"
+  export AIC_ROOT="$(dirname "$PWD")/aiconfigurator-afd-demo"
+  git clone https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiconfigurator.git "$AIC_ROOT"
+  git -C "$AIC_ROOT" checkout --detach 6cd6f9686ab7de6e8fb28171d6e350ee0aa4ed39
+  python3 -m pip install -e "$AIC_ROOT/aic-core"
+  PYTHONPATH="$PWD/tools/sglang-simulator/src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" \
+    python3 tools/sglang-simulator/examples/afd_serving/public_aic.py \
+    --source-root "$SOURCE" \
+    --systems-path "$AIC_ROOT/aic-core/src/aiconfigurator_core/systems" \
+    --output "$PWD/experiments/afd-public"
+)
+```
+
+For an existing pinned AIC install, run only the Python command.
+`public_aic.py` generates shapes, queries public GEMM/Attention/MoE costs, supplies
+explicit formulas for other components, and executes four fixed steps. No private
+inputs are read; failed queries stop. Outputs: `*-costs.json`, `*-result.json`, `summary.json`.
+
+| Formula input | Assumption, not fitted |
+| :--- | :--- |
+| Memory / endpoint link bandwidth | 6.4 TB/s / 900 GB/s |
+| Auxiliary launch / grouped communication startup | 3 µs / 10 µs |
+| Per-step replay / metadata budget | 5 µs / 10 µs |
+
+Ordinary AIC prediction supports `SGLANG_SIMULATOR_AIC_API=legacy|core|auto`;
+`auto` prefers installed core. The public example selects core explicitly.
+`configure_experiment.py --aic-root … --aic-ref …` records either data layout.
+SDK provenance is retained; kernel and page-layout matching remain conditional.
+
+## Demo results
+
+**HTTP control:** Direct 8A8F/S2 on Linux CPU; 16 requests × 4 input / 3 output
+tokens. All 48 output tokens completed through one prefill and two decode
+iterations, with request/event clocks reconciled. Synthetic costs test control flow only.
+
+**Performance:** SM103, Qwen3-235B, Direct 8A8F/S2, TRTLLM + NCCL Direct + DeepGEMM,
+FP8 KV. All throughput values are **token/s / all 16 A+F devices**.
+
+| Effective KV | Batch | Reference pages | Service reference | Expanded AIC | Error |
+| ---: | ---: | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| 8448 | 256 | Shared prefix | 639.607 | 587.386 | −8.16% |
+| 8448 | 512 | Shared prefix | 1198.319 | 1084.844 | −9.47% |
+| 65792 | 256 | Shared prefix | 549.155 | 527.620 | −3.92% |
+| 40320 | 256 | Independent | 521.951 | 492.640 | −5.62% |
+
+*Expanded AIC supplements the existing database with additional operator measurements.*
+
+Public comparison: core 0.12.0 at the revision pinned above, SGLang data 0.5.14;
+same event graph, public queries plus explicit formulas, no private costs.
+
+| Effective KV | Batch | Reference pages | Service reference | Public AIC | Error |
+| ---: | ---: | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| 8448 | 256 | Shared prefix | 639.607 | 776.979 | +21.48% |
+| 8448 | 512 | Shared prefix | 1198.319 | 1255.308 | +4.76% |
+| 65792 | 256 | Shared prefix | 549.155 | 316.363 | −42.39% |
+| 40320 | 256 | Independent | 521.951 | 433.499 | −16.95% |
+
+Main public-cost differences:
+
+- **8K:** TRTLLM MoE tables replace the measured DeepGEMM local-expert cost, lowering FFN cost.
+- **64K:** Attention lookup has no shared-prefix page-layout key.
+- **40K:** Attention cost is 20.4% higher; runtime matching remains unverified.
+
+### Result scope
+
+| Interpretation | Scope |
+| :--- | :--- |
+| Equal-weight MAPE | **Expanded AIC 6.79%; public 21.39%**; `mean(abs(prediction/reference − 1)) × 100` |
+| Reproduction | Expanded AIC rerun unchanged. Public predictions use the command above. |
+| Matching | Shared prefixes: 7360 / 7360 / 58944 tokens; historical page maps, runtime and cache state only partially matched. |
+| Calibration | No scale/offset fit. Better cost coverage/alignment may improve accuracy; not yet validated. |
+| Qualification | Conditional fixed-step comparison, separate from HTTP control validation. Page sharing is not inferred automatically. |
+
+**Time per case**
+
+| Method | Elapsed time | Included work |
+| :--- | ---: | :--- |
+| sglang-simulator | **1.29–6.69 seconds** | Fixed-step prediction, imports, checks and result JSON |
+| Service measurement | **2.3–9.4 minutes** | Two warmups + one formal run, after the service is ready |
+
+Simulation: Python 3.11.15; prepared costs, one timing per case.
+Service: same-topology independent inputs, ISL 8K/64K, B256/512, OSL512;
+these are recent runs, not the historical accuracy references. Setup and cost
+preparation are excluded. Fixed-step prediction and full request generation
+cover different work, so these times are not an end-to-end speedup ratio.

+"""Create a synthetic fixed-cohort HTTP control case, not performance data."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sglang_simulator.afd.adapters import create_adapter
+from sglang_simulator.afd.costs import template
+from sglang_simulator.afd.native_config import NativeAFDConfig
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    p.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--ffn-backend", choices=("fixed", "direct"), default="direct")
+    p.add_argument("--rendezvous-port", type=int, default=1239)
+    a = p.parse_args()
+    if a.output.exists():
+        p.error("output must be new")
+    native = dict(
+        stages=2,
+        lanes=8,
+        attention_lanes=8,
+        ffn_backend=a.ffn_backend,
+        attention_backend="trtllm_mha",
+        rendezvous_host="127.0.0.1",
+        rendezvous_port=a.rendezvous_port,
+    )
+    resolved = NativeAFDConfig.parse(native)
+    adapter = create_adapter(a.source_root, "afd", routing=resolved.routing)
+    adapter.verify()
+    a.output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    catalog = dict(
+        schema_version=1,
+        decode=[],
+        prefill=[
+            dict(
+                requests=[[4, 0]] * 16,
+                duration_ns=1000000,
+                basis="fixture",
+                source="Synthetic complete-batch prefill, not measured",
+            )
+        ],
+    )
+    for kv in (5, 6):

+        name = f"decode-B16-KV{kv}.json"
+        (a.output / name).write_text(json.dumps(costs, indent=2) + "\n")
+        catalog["decode"].append(name)
+    (a.output / "catalog.json").write_text(json.dumps(catalog, indent=2) + "\n")
+    (a.output / "native.json").write_text(json.dumps(native, indent=2) + "\n")
+    sim = dict(
+        platform=dict(
+            accelerator=dict(name="a100_sxm"),

+
+def analytical(key, s):
+    """Declared demo assumptions, not calibrated hardware measurements."""
+    bw, link, launch = 6.4e12, 900e9, 3000
+    if key == "direct_pack":
+        payload = s["rows"] * (s["hidden"] * 2 + s["topk"] * 12)
+        ns, eq = 6 * launch + 2 * payload / bw * 1e9, "6*3000 + 2*payload/6.4e12*1e9"
+    elif key == "direct_combine":
+        ns = 2 * launch + s["rows"] * s["hidden"] * (s["F"] * 2 + 10) / bw * 1e9
+        eq = "2*3000 + rows*hidden*(F*2+10)/6.4e12*1e9"
+    elif key == "direct_group_startup":
+        ns, eq = s["alpha_ns"], "alpha_ns once per grouped exchange"
+    elif key in ("direct_A2F_message", "direct_F2A_message"):
+        ns, eq = s["bytes"] / s["bandwidth_Bps"] * 1e9, "bytes/bandwidth_Bps*1e9"
+    elif key in ("lm_hidden_gather", "logits_exchange"):
+        size = (
+            s["global_bytes"] / s["world"]
+            if key == "lm_hidden_gather"
+            else s["per_rank_input_bytes"]
+        )
+        ns = (s["world"] - 1) * (10000 + size / link * 1e9)
+        eq = "(world-1)*(10000+chunk_bytes/900e9*1e9)"
+    elif key in ("graph_replay_overhead", "ffn_step_submit", "trt_metadata"):
+        ns = 10000 if key == "trt_metadata" else 5000
+        eq = "declared host budget: 10000ns metadata, 5000ns replay/submit per actor/step"
+    elif key in {
+        "input_norm_first",
+        "input_norm_residual",
+        "post_attention_norm",
+        "qk_norm_rope",
+        "topk",
+        "embedding",
+        "final_norm",
+        "logits_postprocess",
+        "sampling",
+        "stage_join",
+    }:
+        ns = (
+            launch
+            + s.get("rows", 1) * s.get("hidden", s.get("vocab", 4096)) * 6 / bw * 1e9
+        )
+        eq = "3000 + rows*width*6/6.4e12*1e9; width=hidden or vocab, otherwise 4096"
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"No declared formula for {key}")
+    return dict(
+        shape=s,
+        duration_ns=ns,
+        basis="formula",
+        equation=eq,
+        source="Explicit unmeasured demo assumption; no scale/offset fit",
+    )
+
+
+def cost(sdk, db, systems, key, s):
+    if key in ("qkv", "o", "router", "lm_head"):
+        kind = "gemm"
+        args = dict(
+            m=s["m"],
+            n=s["n"],
+            k=s["k"],

+    elif key == "trtllm_decode":
+        kind = "generation_attention"
+        args = dict(
+            b=s["rows"],
+            s=s["effective_kv"],
+            n=64,
+            n_kv=4,

+            quant="fp8",

+    elif key == "routed_experts_local_combine":

+            hidden_size=4096,
+            inter_size=1536,
+            topk=8,
+            num_experts=128,
+            moe_tp_size=1,
+            moe_ep_size=s["ep"],
+            quant="fp8_block",
+            workload_distribution="balanced",
+            is_context=False,
+            moe_backend="DEEPGEMM",
+        )
+    else:
+        return analytical(key, s)
+    quote = sdk.query(db, kind, systems_path=str(systems), **args)
+    source = str(quote["sdk_source"]).lower()
+    if source not in ("silicon", "sol", "empirical", "estimated"):

+def main():

+    parser.add_argument("--systems-path", type=Path, required=True)

+        (args.output / f"{stem}-costs.json").write_text(

+
+

+    try:

+    revision = run("rev-parse", "HEAD")

+    return {

+def create_adapter(source_root, mode, *, factory=None, routing="f-side"):

+"""Native A/F control -> existing HiSim coordinator, CPU hooks only.
+
+Kernel hooks consume costs; native pipeline, grouping and TBO bodies are unchanged.
+Synthetic providers are regression inputs and never yield production throughput.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+import dataclasses
+import functools
+import types
+import typing
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from ...coordinator import EventCoordinator
+from .loader import extract, temporary_modules
+from .source import verify_source
+
+
+def run(provider, *, source_root, F=8, layers=94, stage_rows=16, full_decode=False):
+    verify_source(source_root, mode="afd")
+    mod = types.ModuleType("af_native_extracted")
+    with temporary_modules({mod.__name__: mod}):
+        return _run(
+            provider,
+            source_root=source_root,
+            F=F,
+            layers=layers,
+            stage_rows=stage_rows,
+            full_decode=full_decode,
+            env=mod.__dict__,
+        )
+
+
+def _run(provider, *, source_root, F, layers, stage_rows, full_decode, env):
+    BASE = Path(source_root) / "python/sglang/srt"
+    if F not in (2, 4, 8):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported F topology")
+    clock = EventCoordinator()
+    collectors = {}
+    wires = {}
+    actors = []
+    env.update({k: v for k, v in vars(typing).items() if not k.startswith("__")})
+    env.update(
+        dataclass=dataclasses.dataclass,
+        replace=dataclasses.replace,
+        contextmanager=contextlib.contextmanager,
+        nullcontext=contextlib.nullcontext,
+        partial=functools.partial,
+        operations_nvtx_range=lambda **kw: contextlib.nullcontext(),
+        stage_forward_context=lambda *_: contextlib.nullcontext(),
+        AFDError=ValueError,
+        AFDRole=types.SimpleNamespace(ATTENTION="A", FFN="F"),
+    )
+    extract(BASE / "batch_overlap/operations.py", env)
+    extract(BASE / "afd/layer_executor.py", env, ["execute_layer_operations"])
+    extract(BASE / "afd/pipeline.py", env, ["_run_layers"], "AFDAttentionPipeline")
+    a_run = env.pop("_run_layers")
+    extract(BASE / "afd/pipeline.py", env, ["_run_layers"], "AFDFFNPipeline")
+    f_run = env.pop("_run_layers")
+    extract(
+        BASE / "afd/model_adapters/base.py",
+        env,
+        ["local_compute", "_group_ffn_output", "_compute_ffn_output"],
+        "AFDDecoderAdapter",
+    )
+    current = [None]
+
+    class Tensor:
+        def __init__(self, rows, stage=0):
+            self.shape = (rows, 4096)
+            self.stage = stage
+            self.dtype = "bfloat16"
+            self.device = "cpu-symbolic"
+
+        def __getitem__(self, key):
+            return self
+
+        def __setitem__(self, key, value):
+            pass
+
+        def narrow(self, axis, offset, rows):
+            return Tensor(rows, self.stage)
+
+    class Actor:
+        def __init__(self, role, rank):
+            self.role = role
+            self.rank = rank
+            self.name = f"{role}{rank}"
+            self.last = None
+            self.streams = {}
+            self.position = (0, 0)
+            self.recv_count = [0, 0]
+            actors.append(self)
+
+        def deps(self, stream=None):
+            return tuple(
+                dict.fromkeys(
+                    e for e in (self.last, self.streams.get(stream)) if e is not None
+                )
+            )
+
+        def compute(self, kind, **meta):
+            eid = clock.submit(
+                self.name,
+                kind,
+                provider.quote(
+                    kind,
+                    role=self.role,
+                    rank=self.rank,
+                    layer=self.position[0],
+                    stage=self.position[1],
+                    **meta,
+                ),
+                deps=self.deps(),
+                resources=(self.name + ".compute",),
+                metadata=dict(layer=self.position[0], stage=self.position[1], **meta),
+            )
+            self.last = eid
+            return eid
+
+        def transfer(self, direction, a, layer, stage, endpoint):
+            key = (direction, a, layer, stage)
+            if key not in wires:
+                wires[key] = {
+                    "event": clock.reserve(
+                        "wire",
+                        direction,
+                        metadata=dict(A=a, F=a // (8 // F), layer=layer, stage=stage),
+                    ),
+                    "posts": {},
+                }
+            item = wires[key]
+            if endpoint in item["posts"]:
+                raise ValueError("duplicate wire endpoint")
+            item["posts"][endpoint] = self.deps(direction)
+            eid = item["event"]
+            self.streams[direction] = eid
+            if len(item["posts"]) == 2:
+                deps = tuple(
+                    dict.fromkeys(x for v in item["posts"].values() for x in v)
+                )
+                clock.resolve(
+                    eid,
+                    deps=deps,
+                    duration_ns=provider.quote(
+                        "p2p",
+                        direction=direction,
+                        bytes=stage_rows * 4096 * 2,
+                        A=a,
+                        F=a // (8 // F),
+                    ),
+                    resources=(f"link.A{a}.F{a // (8 // F)}.{direction}",),
+                )
+            return eid
+
+        def collective(self, kind):
+            layer, stage = self.position
+            key = (kind, layer, stage)
+            if key not in collectors:
+                collectors[key] = {
+                    "event": clock.reserve(
+                        "F-group",
+                        kind,
+                        metadata=dict(layer=layer, stage=stage, world=F),
+                    ),
+                    "posts": {},
+                }
+            item = collectors[key]

+"""Load native function bodies and scope process-local import hooks.
+
+Adapter calls serialize temporary module substitutions. Other threads running
+real SGLang/Torch are outside this lock; do not co-host them during a simulation.
+No subprocess or separate service is required.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import sys
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from threading import RLock
+
+_MODULE_LOCK = RLock()
+_MISSING = object()
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def temporary_modules(replacements):
+    with _MODULE_LOCK:
+        saved = {name: sys.modules.get(name, _MISSING) for name in replacements}
+        try:
+            sys.modules.update(replacements)
+            yield
+        finally:
+            for name, value in saved.items():
+                if value is _MISSING:
+                    sys.modules.pop(name, None)
+                else:
+                    sys.modules[name] = value
+
+
+def extract(path, env, names=None, cls=None):
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+    nodes = (
+        tree.body
+        if cls is None
+        else next(
+            n.body for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == cls
+        )
+    )
+    selected = [
+        n
+        for n in nodes
+        if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))
+        and (names is None or n.name in names)
+    ]
+    if names is not None:
+        if {n.name for n in selected} != set(names):
+            raise ValueError(f"AFD_SOURCE_API_MISMATCH: {path}: {cls}: {names}")
+    body = [
+        ast.ImportFrom(
+            module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0
+        )
+    ] + selected
+    exec(
+        compile(
+            ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=body, type_ignores=[])),
+            str(path),
+            "exec",
+        ),
+        env,
+    )

+def verify_source(source_root, *, mode=None, routing="f-side"):

+        "batch_overlap/operations.py": [
+            "execute_operations",
+            "execute_overlapped_operations",
+            "YieldOperation",
+            "ExecutionOperation",
+        ],
+        "afd/layer_executor.py": ["execute_layer_operations"],
+        "afd/pipeline.py": ["AFDAttentionPipeline._run_layers"],
+    }
+    if routing == "direct":
+        required["afd/expert_exchange.py"] = [
+            "combine_partials",
+            "AFDDirectExchange.dispatch",
+            "AFDDirectExchange._exchange",
+            "AFDDirectExchange.run_ffn_step",
+            "AFDDirectExchange.run_layer",

+            "AFDDecoderAdapter.local_compute",
+            "AFDDecoderAdapter._group_ffn_output",

+        name = "python/sglang/srt/" + relative

+        if not path.is_file() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):

+                    None,
+                )
+                if node is None:
+                    raise ValueError(f"AFD_SOURCE_API_MISMATCH: {name}: {symbol}")
+        files.append(name)

+"""Pure integer-nanosecond DAG scheduling; no runtime or model integration.
+
+Resource IDs are hashable, unit-capacity tokens shared across all actors/domains.
+Callers supply stream dependencies and FIFO sequence ordinals explicitly. Matching
+uses the complete communication key, never layer metadata or arrival sorting.
+Times are recomputed after graph changes; consume them only once inputs are ready.
+"""
+
+from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush
+
+
+class DeadlockError(RuntimeError):
+    """Unscheduled events, including unmatched receive keys, in ``wait_graph``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, wait_graph):
+        self.wait_graph = wait_graph
+        super().__init__(f"Unresolved event wait graph: {wait_graph!r}")
+
+
+class EventCoordinator:
+    def __init__(self, *, defer_cycle_checks=False):
+        # Complete-graph adapters can avoid repeated transitive DFS while
+        # resolving many forward receive handles. drain still rejects cycles;
+        # no partial readiness may be observed in this mode.
+        if type(defer_cycle_checks) is not bool:
+            raise ValueError("defer_cycle_checks must be a bool")
+        self._defer_cycle_checks = defer_cycle_checks
+        self._events = []
+        self._unresolved = set()
+        self._messages = {"send": {}, "recv": {}}
+        self._pending_receives = {}
+        self._timed_events = []
+        self._max_referenced_id = -1
+        self._resolved_events = set()
+        self._committed_times = []
+
+    def is_resolved(self, event_id):
+        if self._defer_cycle_checks:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Complete-graph mode requires drain/finish before observation"
+            )
+        self._event(event_id)
+        pending = [(event_id, False)]
+        while pending:
+            current, visited = pending.pop()
+            if current in self._resolved_events:
+                continue
+            event = self._events[current]
+            if event["duration"] is None:
+                return False
+            if visited:
+                self._resolved_events.add(current)
+            else:
+                pending.append((current, True))
+                pending.extend(
+                    (dep, False)
+                    for dep in event["deps"]
+                    if dep not in self._resolved_events
+                )
+        return True
+
+    def _event(self, event_id):
+        if type(event_id) is not int or not 0 <= event_id < len(self._events):
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing event/dependency: {event_id!r}")
+        return self._events[event_id]
+
+    def _validate(self, duration_ns, deps, resources):
+        if type(duration_ns) is not int or duration_ns < 0:
+            raise ValueError("duration_ns must be a non-negative integer")
+        deps = tuple(deps)
+        for dep in deps:
+            self._event(dep)
+        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(deps)), tuple(dict.fromkeys(resources))
+
+    def _check_cycle(self, event_id, deps):
+        if event_id in deps:
+            raise ValueError(f"Dependency cycle through event {event_id}")
+        if self._defer_cycle_checks:
+            return
+        # No existing path can reach an ID beyond all recorded dependency IDs.
+        # This makes ordinary appends cheap, but not the unsafe assumption that
+        # a newest reserved handle cannot already have forward incoming edges.
+        if event_id > self._max_referenced_id:
+            return
+        stack, seen = list(deps), set()
+        while stack:
+            dep = stack.pop()
+            if dep == event_id:
+                raise ValueError(f"Dependency cycle through event {event_id}")
+            if dep not in seen:
+                seen.add(dep)
+                if not self.is_resolved(dep):
+                    stack.extend(self._events[dep]["deps"])
+
+    def _invalidate(self):
+        for event_id in self._timed_events:
+            event = self._events[event_id]
+            event["start_ns"] = event["finish_ns"] = None
+        self._timed_events.clear()
+
+    def reserve(self, actor, kind, domain="", metadata=None):
+        event_id = len(self._events)
+        self._events.append(
+            dict(
+                id=event_id,
+                actor=actor,
+                kind=kind,
+                domain=domain,
+                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
+                deps=(),
+                resources=(),
+                duration=None,
+                start_ns=None,
+                finish_ns=None,
+            )
+        )
+        self._unresolved.add(event_id)
+        self._invalidate()
+        return event_id
+
+    def submit(
+        self, actor, kind, duration_ns, resources=(), deps=(), metadata=None, domain=""
+    ):
+        deps, resources = self._validate(duration_ns, deps, resources)
+        event_id = self.reserve(actor, kind, domain, metadata)
+        self.resolve(event_id, deps, duration_ns, resources)
+        return event_id
+
+    def resolve(self, event_id, deps=(), duration_ns=0, resources=()):
+        event = self._event(event_id)
+        if event["duration"] is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"Event {event_id} already resolved")
+        if event_id in self._pending_receives:
+            raise ValueError("Receive requires a matching send")
+        deps, resources = self._validate(duration_ns, deps, resources)
+        self._check_cycle(event_id, deps)
+        event.update(deps=deps, duration=duration_ns, resources=resources)
+        self._unresolved.remove(event_id)
+        self._max_referenced_id = max(self._max_referenced_id, max(deps, default=-1))
+        self._invalidate()
+
+    def send(
+        self, domain, channel, source, dest, seq, deps=(), duration_ns=0, resources=()
+    ):
+        return self._transfer(
+            "send", domain, channel, source, dest, seq, deps, duration_ns, resources
+        )
+
+    def recv(
+        self, domain, channel, source, dest, seq, deps=(), duration_ns=0, resources=()
+    ):
+        return self._transfer(
+            "recv", domain, channel, source, dest, seq, deps, duration_ns, resources
+        )
+
+    def _transfer(
+        self, kind, domain, channel, source, dest, seq, deps, duration_ns, resources
+    ):
+        key = (domain, channel, source, dest, seq)
+        own = self._messages[kind]
+        if key in own:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate {kind}: {key!r}")
+        deps, resources = self._validate(duration_ns, deps, resources)
+        peer = self._messages["recv" if kind == "send" else "send"].get(key)
+        if kind == "send" and peer is not None:
+            self._check_cycle(peer, deps)  # Reject before mutating either handle.
+        metadata = {"match_key": key}
+        actor = source if kind == "send" else dest
+        if kind == "recv" and peer is None:
+            event_id = self.reserve(actor, kind, domain, metadata)
+            self._events[event_id].update(deps=deps, resources=resources)
+            self._max_referenced_id = max(
+                self._max_referenced_id, max(deps, default=-1)
+            )
+            self._pending_receives[event_id] = duration_ns
+        else:
+            if kind == "recv":
+                deps += (peer,)
+            event_id = self.submit(
+                actor, kind, duration_ns, resources, deps, metadata, domain
+            )
+        own[key] = event_id
+        if kind == "send" and peer is not None:
+            event = self._events[peer]
+            duration = self._pending_receives.pop(peer)
+            self.resolve(
+                peer, event["deps"] + (event_id,), duration, event["resources"]
+            )
+        return event_id
+
+    def drain(self):
+        """Schedule all possible events; raise with the remaining wait graph."""
+        self._invalidate()
+        available = {}
+        dependents = [[] for _ in self._events]
+        remaining = [len(event["deps"]) for event in self._events]
+        dependency_finish = [0] * len(self._events)
+        ready = []
+        for event in self._events:
+            for dep in event["deps"]:
+                dependents[dep].append(event["id"])
+            if not event["deps"] and event["duration"] is not None:
+                ready.append((0, event["id"]))
+        heapify(ready)
+        while ready:
+            earliest, event_id = heappop(ready)
+            event = self._events[event_id]
+            start = max(
+                earliest,
+                max((available.get(r, 0) for r in event["resources"]), default=0),
+            )
+            # Availability only increases: queued times are lower bounds. A
+            # stale candidate must be requeued until its full (start, id) key
+            # beats every other lower bound, including newly ready events.
+            if ready and (start, event_id) > ready[0]:
+                heappush(ready, (start, event_id))
+                continue
+            finish = start + event["duration"]
+            event.update(start_ns=start, finish_ns=finish)
+            self._timed_events.append(event_id)
+            for resource in event["resources"]:
+                available[resource] = finish
+            for dependent in dependents[event_id]:
+                remaining[dependent] -= 1
+                dependency_finish[dependent] = max(dependency_finish[dependent], finish)
+                if (
+                    remaining[dependent] == 0
+                    and self._events[dependent]["duration"] is not None
+                ):
+                    heappush(ready, (dependency_finish[dependent], dependent))
+        if len(self._timed_events) != len(self._events):
+            raise DeadlockError(
+                {
+                    i: dict(
+                        deps=[
+                            d
+                            for d in event["deps"]
+                            if self._events[d]["finish_ns"] is None
+                        ],
+                        unresolved=event["duration"] is None,
+                        actor=event["actor"],
+                        kind=event["kind"],
+                        domain=event["domain"],
+                        metadata=dict(event["metadata"]),
+                    )
+                    for i, event in enumerate(self._events)
+                    if event["finish_ns"] is None
+                }
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def has_unresolved(self):
+        return bool(self._unresolved)
+
+    def checkpoint(self, event_ids):
+        """Commit a complete DP step; future steps must depend on this fence.
+
+        Called only when every A rank has returned from the native pipeline.
+        Rejects incomplete communication and any rewrite of an observed time.
+        """
+        fence = self.submit("DP-host", "decode_step_fence", 0, deps=event_ids)
+        self.drain()
+        for event, expected in zip(self._events, self._committed_times):
+            if (event["start_ns"], event["finish_ns"]) != expected:
+                raise RuntimeError("ONLINE_CLOCK_HISTORY_REWRITTEN")
+        self._committed_times = [(e["start_ns"], e["finish_ns"]) for e in self._events]
+        return fence, self._events[fence]["finish_ns"]
+
+    def finish(self, event_id):
+        self._event(event_id)
+        self.drain()
+        return self._events[event_id]["finish_ns"]
+
+    def export(self):
+        """Return detached records; times are None until drain (or after edits)."""
+        return [
+            dict(
+                e,
+                deps=list(e["deps"]),
+                resources=list(e["resources"]),
+                metadata=dict(e["metadata"]),
+            )
+            for e in self._events
+        ]
+
+    @property
+    def events(self):
+        return self.export()

+"""Model-independent cost records with explicit invocation mapping.
+
+The execution adapter supplies expected signatures and resolves each invocation
+into non-overlapping record keys. No model, backend or rank defaults live here.
+"""
+
+import copy
+import math
+
+from .contracts import CostMapping
+
+
+def template(config, mapping):
+    return {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "fixture": True,
+        "deployment": copy.deepcopy(config),
+        "costs": {
+            key: {
+                "shape": shape,
+                "duration_ns": 10,
+                "basis": "fixture",
+                "source": "Synthetic control-test duration; not a benchmark",
+            }
+            for key, shape in mapping.expected_shapes().items()
+        },
+    }
+
+
+class CostTable:
+    def __init__(self, document, mapping: CostMapping):
+        document = copy.deepcopy(document)
+        if document["schema_version"] != 1 or type(document["fixture"]) is not bool:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_COST_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED")
+        self.config = document["deployment"]
+        self.synthetic = document["fixture"]
+        self.by = document["costs"]
+        self.queries = []
+        self.mapping = copy.deepcopy(mapping)
+        expected = self.mapping.expected_shapes()
+        self._shapes = expected
+        if self.by.keys() != expected.keys():
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AFD_COST_KEYS_MISMATCH: no missing or unused costs allowed"
+            )
+        for key, shape in expected.items():
+            record = self.by[key]
+            ns = record["duration_ns"]
+            if (
+                isinstance(ns, bool)
+                or not isinstance(ns, (int, float))
+                or not math.isfinite(ns)
+                or ns < 1
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"AFD_COST_INVALID: {key}")
+            if (
+                record["shape"] != shape
+                or not isinstance(record["source"], (str, dict))
+                or not record["source"]
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"AFD_COST_SHAPE_OR_SOURCE_MISMATCH: {key}")
+            basis = record["basis"]
+            if basis not in (
+                ("fixture",)
+                if self.synthetic
+                else ("exact", "interpolation", "formula")
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"AFD_COST_BASIS_INVALID: {key}")
+            if basis == "interpolation" and not record.get("neighbors"):
+                raise ValueError(f"AFD_COST_INTERPOLATION_NEIGHBORS_MISSING: {key}")
+            if basis == "formula" and not record.get("equation"):
+                raise ValueError(f"AFD_COST_FORMULA_MISSING: {key}")
+
+    def components(self, kind, **metadata):
+        keys = list(self.mapping.resolve(kind, metadata))
+        if not keys or len(set(keys)) != len(keys):
+            raise ValueError(f"AFD_COST_COMPONENTS_INVALID: {kind}")
+        if any(key not in self.by for key in keys):
+            raise ValueError(f"AFD_COST_QUERY_MISSING: {kind}")
+        return [(key, self.by[key]) for key in keys]
+
+    def event_components(self, event):
+        kind, metadata = self.mapping.event_call(event)
+        return self.components(kind, **metadata)
+
+    def quote(self, kind, **metadata):
+        records = self.components(kind, **metadata)
+        self.queries.append(dict(kind=kind, **metadata))
+        return round(sum(record["duration_ns"] for _, record in records))

+    ffn_ranks: int
+    attention_ranks: int
+    stages: int
+    stage_capacity: int
+
+    @classmethod
+    def parse(cls, value):
+        raw = json.loads(value) if isinstance(value, str) else dict(value)
+        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or raw.keys() - _FIELDS:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED_FIELDS")
+        policy = raw.get("ffn_backend", "auto")
+        if policy not in ("auto", "fixed", "direct"):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_FFN_BACKEND_INVALID")
+        legacy = raw.get("experimental_direct")
+        if legacy is not None:
+            if type(legacy) is not bool:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_DIRECT_CONFIG_INVALID")
+            # Matches native direct_mode: an explicit legacy value takes priority.
+            policy = "direct" if legacy else "fixed"
+        if policy == "auto":
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AFD_AUTO_REQUIRES_NATIVE_CAPABILITY_NEGOTIATION: select fixed or direct for simulation"
+            )
+        if raw.get("experimental_m2n", False) is not False:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_M2N_SIMULATION_UNSUPPORTED")
+        if raw.get("experimental_direct_transport", "nccl") != "nccl":
+            raise ValueError("AFD_DIRECT_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED")
+        ffn = _positive_int(raw.get("lanes", 1), "lanes")
+        attention = raw.get("attention_lanes")
+        attention = (
+            ffn if attention is None else _positive_int(attention, "attention_lanes")
+        )
+        stages = _positive_int(raw.get("stages", 2), "stages")
+        capacity = _positive_int(
+            raw.get("experimental_direct_stage_rows", 32),
+            "experimental_direct_stage_rows",
+        )
+        if attention != 8 or stages != 2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AFD_SIMULATOR_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED: current profiles require 8A/S2"
+            )
+        if raw.get("attention_backend", "trtllm_mha") != "trtllm_mha":
+            raise ValueError("AFD_SIMULATOR_ATTENTION_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED")
+        for key in (
+            "max_hbm_bytes",
+            "rendezvous_port",
+            "rendezvous_timeout_seconds",
+            "idle_timeout_seconds",
+            "close_timeout_seconds",
+            "nccl_num_channels",
+        ):
+            if key in raw:
+                _positive_int(raw[key], key)
+        if raw.get("rendezvous_port", 1239) > 65535:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_CONFIG_INVALID: rendezvous_port")
+        return cls(
+            raw,
+            "direct" if policy == "direct" else "f-side",
+            ffn,
+            attention,
+            stages,
+            capacity,
+        )
+
+    def check(self, deployment):
+        if deployment["mode"] != "afd" or deployment["ffn_ranks"] != self.ffn_ranks:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_NATIVE_DEPLOYMENT_MISMATCH")
+        if deployment.get("routing", "f-side") != self.routing:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_NATIVE_ROUTING_MISMATCH")
+        if (
+            self.routing == "direct"
+            and deployment["batch_size"] // 16 > self.stage_capacity
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_DIRECT_BUFFER_CAPACITY")
+
+
+def select_native_config(value=None, *, routing=None, ffn_ranks=None):
+    native = NativeAFDConfig.parse(value) if value is not None else None
+    if native and routing is not None and routing != native.routing:
+        raise ValueError("AFD_ROUTING_ARGUMENT_CONFLICT")
+    if native and ffn_ranks is not None and ffn_ranks != native.ffn_ranks:
+        raise ValueError("AFD_FFN_RANK_ARGUMENT_CONFLICT")
+    return (
+        native,
+        native.routing if native else (routing or "f-side"),
+        native.ffn_ranks if native else (8 if ffn_ranks is None else ffn_ranks),
+    )

+"""Decode orchestration and result accounting, independent of native objects."""
+
+from .contracts import ExecutionAdapter

+def critical_path(events, provider):
+    by = {event["id"]: event for event in events}
+    # Preserve the existing max-ID tie rule without scanning the complete
+    # multi-rank graph at every resource wait on the critical path.
+    resource_end = {}
+    for event in events:
+        if event["duration"] > 0:
+            for resource in event["resources"]:
+                key = event["finish_ns"], resource
+                resource_end[key] = (
+                    max(resource_end[key], event["id"])
+                    if key in resource_end
+                    else event["id"]
+                )
+    current = max(events, key=lambda event: (event["finish_ns"], event["id"]))
+    path, seen = [], set()
+    while True:
+        if current["id"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_CRITICAL_PATH_CYCLE")
+        seen.add(current["id"])
+        path.append(current)
+        deps = [
+            by[key]
+            for key in current["deps"]
+            if by[key]["finish_ns"] == current["start_ns"]
+        ]
+        if deps:
+            current = max(deps, key=lambda event: event["id"])
+            continue
+        if current["start_ns"] == 0:
+            break
+        previous = [
+            resource_end[key]
+            for resource in current["resources"]
+            if (key := (current["start_ns"], resource)) in resource_end
+        ]
+        if not previous:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_UNEXPLAINED_RESOURCE_WAIT")
+        current = by[max(previous)]
+    total = sum(event["duration"] for event in path)
+    assert total == max(event["finish_ns"] for event in events)
+    contributions = dict(exact=0.0, interpolation=0.0, formula=0.0, fixture=0.0)
+    for event in path:
+        if not event["duration"]:
+            continue
+        records = provider.event_components(event)
+        denominator = sum(record["duration_ns"] for _, record in records)
+        for _, record in records:
+            contributions[record["basis"]] += (
+                event["duration"] * record["duration_ns"] / denominator
+            )
+    return {
+        "duration_ns": total,
+        "contributions_ns": contributions,
+        "declared_exact_interpolation_fraction": (
+            contributions["exact"] + contributions["interpolation"]
+        )
+        / total,
+    }
+
+
+def simulate(document, *, source_root=None, adapter: ExecutionAdapter | None = None):
+    config = document["deployment"]
+    if adapter is None:
+        from .adapters import create_adapter
+
+        adapter = create_adapter(
+            source_root, config["mode"], routing=config.get("routing", "f-side")
+        )
+    provider = CostTable(document, adapter.cost_mapping(config))
+    config = provider.config
+    trace = adapter.execute(provider)
+    devices = trace.total_devices
+    path = critical_path(trace.events, provider)
+    end = path["duration_ns"]
+    return {
+        "kind": (
+            "control_fixture" if provider.synthetic else "conditional_decode_estimate"
+        ),
+        "deployment": config,
+        "source_files": trace.source_files,
+        "total_devices": devices,
+        "control_completion_ns": end,
+        "step_ms": None if provider.synthetic else end / 1e6,
+        "total_tgs": None if provider.synthetic else config["batch_size"] * 1e9 / end,
+        "per_device_tgs": (
+            None if provider.synthetic else config["batch_size"] * 1e9 / end / devices
+        ),
+        "capacity_fit": "unknown",
+        "service_admitted": False,
+        "service_accuracy_verified": False,
+        "critical_path": path,
+        "cost_ledger": document["costs"],
+        "events": trace.events,

+            "Single module costs and explicit dependency/resource assumptions do not prove service overlap or contention",
+            "Timing is conditioned on capacity fit; cost provenance is caller-declared, not independently certified",

+    }

+"""Bounded CPU AFD task service: no inference HTTP endpoint or device runtime.
+
+The F process owns a central virtual event graph for all modeled A/F ranks.
+The A process keeps the real Scheduler/request lifecycle. Loopback control RPC
+wall time is not the modeled A2F/F2A link latency; those costs stay in the graph.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import socket
+import socketserver
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .adapters import create_adapter
+from .native_config import NativeAFDConfig
+from .runner import simulate
+
+MAX_MESSAGE = 4 * 1024 * 1024
+
+
+def _signature(native):
+    return dict(
+        routing=native.routing,
+        attention_ranks=native.attention_ranks,
+        ffn_ranks=native.ffn_ranks,
+        stages=native.stages,
+        stage_capacity=native.stage_capacity,
+        attention_backend=native.raw.get("attention_backend", "trtllm_mha"),
+    )
+
+
+def _read_message(stream):
+    line = stream.readline(MAX_MESSAGE + 1)
+    if not line or len(line) > MAX_MESSAGE or not line.endswith(b"\n"):
+        raise ValueError("AFD_TASK_MESSAGE_INVALID_OR_TOO_LARGE")
+    value = json.loads(line)
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError("AFD_TASK_MESSAGE_MUST_BE_AN_OBJECT")
+    return value
+
+
+def _write_message(stream, value):
+    wire = json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False).encode() + b"\n"
+    if len(wire) > MAX_MESSAGE:
+        raise ValueError("AFD_TASK_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE")
+    stream.write(wire)
+    stream.flush()
+
+
+class CostCatalog:
+    """Exact workload lookup; no nearest-neighbor, zero or legacy fallback."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path, source_root, native, *, allow_fixture=False):
+        path = Path(path)
+        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
+        if data.get("schema_version") != 1:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_CATALOG_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED")
+        self.adapter = create_adapter(source_root, "afd", routing=native.routing)
+        self.adapter.verify()
+        self.native = native
+        self.decode = {}
+        self.prefill = {}
+        self.fixture = False
+        for relative in data.get("decode", []):
+            p = (path.parent / relative).resolve()
+            document = json.loads(p.read_text())
+            native.check(document["deployment"])
+            from .costs import CostTable
+
+            CostTable(document, self.adapter.cost_mapping(document["deployment"]))
+            if document["fixture"] and not allow_fixture:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_SERVING_FIXTURE_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_OPT_IN")
+            self.fixture |= document["fixture"]
+            c = document["deployment"]
+            key = c["batch_size"], c["effective_kv"]
+            if key in self.decode:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_CATALOG_DUPLICATE_DECODE_KEY")
+            self.decode[key] = document
+        for row in data.get("prefill", []):
+            key = tuple(sorted(tuple(x) for x in row["requests"]))
+            ns = row["duration_ns"]
+            basis = row["basis"]
+            if not key or any(
+                len(x) != 2 or any(type(v) is not int or v < 0 for v in x) or x[0] < 1
+                for x in key
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("AFD_PREFILL_REQUEST_SHAPE_INVALID")
+            if type(ns) is not int or ns < 1 or not row.get("source"):
+                raise ValueError("AFD_PREFILL_COST_INVALID")
+            if basis not in ("exact", "interpolation", "formula", "fixture"):
+                raise ValueError("AFD_PREFILL_COST_BASIS_INVALID")
+            if basis == "formula" and not row.get("equation"):
+                raise ValueError("AFD_PREFILL_FORMULA_MISSING")
+            if basis == "interpolation" and not row.get("neighbors"):
+                raise ValueError("AFD_PREFILL_NEIGHBORS_MISSING")
+            if basis == "fixture" and not allow_fixture:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_SERVING_FIXTURE_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_OPT_IN")
+            self.fixture |= basis == "fixture"
+            if key in self.prefill:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_CATALOG_DUPLICATE_PREFILL_KEY")
+            self.prefill[key] = row
+        if not self.decode:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_CATALOG_DECODE_COSTS_REQUIRED")
+        self.digest = hashlib.sha256(
+            json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True).encode()
+        ).hexdigest()
+
+    def execute(self, requests, phase):
+        if not requests or len({r["id"] for r in requests}) != len(requests):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_REQUEST_IDENTITIES_REQUIRED_AND_UNIQUE")
+        for r in requests:
+            if not isinstance(r["id"], str) or not r["id"]:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_REQUEST_ID_INVALID")
+            if (
+                any(type(r[k]) is not int or r[k] < 0 for k in ("extend", "past"))
+                or r["extend"] < 1
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("AFD_REQUEST_LENGTH_INVALID")
+        if phase == "prefill":
+            key = tuple(sorted((r["extend"], r["past"]) for r in requests))
+            if key not in self.prefill:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "AFD_PREFILL_COST_MISSING: exact request composition required"
+                )
+            row = self.prefill[key]
+            return dict(
+                duration_ns=row["duration_ns"],
+                request_finish_ns={r["id"]: row["duration_ns"] for r in requests},
+                placement={},
+                method="declared_prefill_batch_cost",
+                basis=row["basis"],
+                source=row["source"],
+            )
+        if phase != "decode" or any(r["extend"] != 1 for r in requests):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_BATCH_PHASE_INVALID")
+        kvs = {r["past"] + 1 for r in requests}
+        if len(kvs) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("AFD_NONUNIFORM_KV_REQUIRES_REQUEST_AWARE_ADAPTER")
+        key = len(requests), next(iter(kvs))
+        if key not in self.decode:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"AFD_DECODE_COST_MISSING: batch={key[0]}, effective_kv={key[1]}"
+            )
+        document = self.decode[key]
+        result = simulate(document, adapter=self.adapter)
+        rows = key[0] // 16
+        ready = {
+            e["actor"]: e["finish_ns"]
+            for e in result["events"]
+            if e["kind"] == "sampling"
+        }
+        placement = {
+            r["id"]: dict(
+                attention_rank=i // (2 * rows), stage=(i // rows) % 2, slot=i % rows
+            )
+            for i, r in enumerate(requests)
+        }
+        finishes = {
+            rid: ready["A" + str(pos["attention_rank"])]
+            for rid, pos in placement.items()
+        }
+        return dict(
+            duration_ns=result["control_completion_ns"],
+            request_finish_ns=finishes,
+            placement=placement,
+            method="source_bound_afd_event_graph",
+            critical_path=result["critical_path"],
+            source_files=result["source_files"],
+            events=result["events"],
+            deployment=result["deployment"],
+        )
+
+
+class AFDTaskServer(socketserver.TCPServer):
+    allow_reuse_address = False
+
+    def __init__(self, native, catalog, output_dir):
+        host = native.raw.get("rendezvous_host", "127.0.0.1")
+        if host not in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost"):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_TASK_SERVICE_LOOPBACK_ONLY")
+        self.native = native
+        self.catalog = catalog
+        self.output = Path(output_dir)
+        self.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+        self.sequence = 0
+
+        class Handler(socketserver.StreamRequestHandler):
+            def handle(inner):
+                inner.connection.settimeout(120)
+                try:
+                    request = _read_message(inner.rfile)
+                    response = self.dispatch(request)
+                    _write_message(inner.wfile, dict(ok=True, **response))
+                except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, OSError) as exc:
+                    _write_message(
+                        inner.wfile,
+                        dict(ok=False, error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"),
+                    )
+
+        super().__init__((host, native.raw.get("rendezvous_port", 1239)), Handler)
+        manifest = dict(
+            kind="afd_cpu_internal_task_service",
+            address=list(self.server_address),
+            native_afd_config=native.raw,
+            signature=_signature(native),
+            catalog_sha256=catalog.digest,
+            fixture=catalog.fixture,
+            capacity_fit="unknown",
+            service_accuracy_verified=False,
+        )
+        (self.output / "SERVICE.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+    def dispatch(self, request):
+        if request.get("signature") != _signature(self.native):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_PEER_CONFIG_MISMATCH")
+        if request.get("op") == "handshake":
+            return dict(
+                signature=_signature(self.native),
+                catalog_sha256=self.catalog.digest,
+                fixture=self.catalog.fixture,
+                kind="afd_cpu_internal_task_service",
+            )
+        if request.get("op") != "batch":
+            raise ValueError("AFD_TASK_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED")
+        result = self.catalog.execute(request["requests"], request["phase"])
+        sequence = self.sequence
+        self.sequence += 1
+        record = dict(
+            sequence=sequence,
+            requests=request["requests"],
+            phase=request["phase"],
+            **result,
+        )
+        (self.output / f"step-{sequence:06d}.json").write_text(
+            json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n"
+        )
+        result.pop("events", None)
+        return dict(sequence=sequence, fixture=self.catalog.fixture, **result)
+
+
+class AFDTaskClient:
+    def __init__(self, native, *, timeout=120):
+        self.native = native
+        self.timeout = timeout
+        self.request("handshake")
+
+    def request(self, op, **payload):
+        host = self.native.raw.get("rendezvous_host", "127.0.0.1")
+        if host not in ("localhost", "127.0.0.1"):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_TASK_SERVICE_LOOPBACK_ONLY")
+        with socket.create_connection(
+            (host, self.native.raw.get("rendezvous_port", 1239)), timeout=self.timeout
+        ) as sock:
+            with sock.makefile("rwb") as stream:
+                _write_message(
+                    stream, dict(op=op, signature=_signature(self.native), **payload)
+                )
+                result = _read_message(stream)
+        if not result.get("ok"):
+            raise ValueError("AFD_F_TASK_FAILED: " + result.get("error", "unknown"))
+        return result
+

+class AFDRequestPredictor:
+    """Scheduler predictor bridge; returns per-request graph completion offsets."""
+
+    uses_virtual_event_time = True
+    requires_exact_request_context = True
+
+    def __init__(self, model=None, hw=None, config=None, *, afd_config):
+        self.model, self.hw, self.config = model, hw, config
+        if model is not None:
+            expected = dict(
+                hidden_size=4096,
+                num_hidden_layers=94,
+                num_attention_heads=64,
+                num_key_value_heads=4,
+                head_dim=128,
+                vocab_size=151936,
+            )
+            if any(getattr(model, k, None) != v for k, v in expected.items()):
+                raise ValueError("AFD_REQUEST_MODEL_PROFILE_MISMATCH")
+            hf = model.hf_config
+
+            def get(name):
+                return hf.get(name) if isinstance(hf, dict) else getattr(hf, name, None)
+
+            if get("num_experts") != 128 or get("num_experts_per_tok") != 8:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_REQUEST_EXPERT_PROFILE_MISMATCH")
+        self.native = NativeAFDConfig.parse(afd_config)
+        self.client = AFDTaskClient(self.native)
+        self.last = None
+        self.placements = {}
+        self.steps = []
+
+    def predict_infer_time(self, batch):
+        phase = getattr(batch, "forward_phase", None) or (
+            "decode" if batch.is_decode() else "prefill"
+        )
+        requests = [
+            dict(id=r.request_id, extend=r.extend_length, past=r.past_kv_length)
+            for r in batch.reqs
+        ]
+        result = self.client.request("batch", requests=requests, phase=phase)
+        for rid, where in result["placement"].items():
+            if rid in self.placements and self.placements[rid] != where:
+                raise ValueError("AFD_REQUEST_MIGRATION_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_MODEL")
+        self.placements = {
+            rid: p
+            for rid, p in self.placements.items()
+            if rid in result["request_finish_ns"]
+        }
+        self.placements.update(result["placement"])
+        self.last = result
+        self.steps.append(
+            dict(
+                sequence=result["sequence"],
+                phase=phase,
+                method=result["method"],
+                fixture=result["fixture"],
+            )
+        )
+        return result["duration_ns"] / 1e9
+
+    def completion_offsets(self):
+        return (
+            {rid: ns / 1e9 for rid, ns in self.last["request_finish_ns"].items()}
+            if self.last
+            else {}
+        )
+
+    def get_metrics(self):
+        return dict(
+            afd_steps=self.steps,
+            afd_fixture=bool(self.last and self.last["fixture"]),
+            afd_capacity_fit="unknown",
+            afd_service_accuracy_verified=False,
+            afd_host_overhead="cost-ledger events only; CPU interpreter and control-RPC wall time excluded",
+        )
+
+    def reset_metrics(self):
+        self.steps = []

+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang_simulator.simulation.sglang import scheduler as hooks
+
+
+class SchedulerAFDBridgeTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_prefill_decode_metadata_and_virtual_request_time(self):
+        class GenerationBatchResult:
+            pass
+
+        class Scheduler:
+            def __init__(self):
+                pass
+
+            def recv_requests(self):
+                return []
+
+            def _prefetch_kvcache(self):
+                pass
+
+            get_new_batch_prefill = event_loop_normal = init_request_dispatcher = (
+                _prefetch_kvcache
+            )
+
+            def run_batch(self, batch):
+                return GenerationBatchResult()
+
+            def process_batch_result(self, batch, result):
+                for req in batch.reqs:
+                    req.output_ids.append(1)
+
+        reqs = [
+            NS(
+                rid=r,
+                origin_input_ids=[1, 2, 3, 4],
+                prefix_indices=[],
+                output_ids=[],
+                extend_range=NS(length=4),
+            )
+            for r in ("r0", "r1")
+        ]
+        phase = ["prefill"]
+        mode = NS(
+            is_extend=lambda: phase[0] == "prefill",
+            is_decode=lambda: phase[0] == "decode",
+        )
+        batch, seen = NS(reqs=reqs, forward_mode=mode), []
+
+        def predict(b):
+            seen.append(b)
+            return 0.02
+
+        predictor = NS(
+            uses_virtual_event_time=True,
+            predict_infer_time=predict,
+            completion_offsets=lambda: {"r0": 0.01, "r1": 0.02},
+        )
+        hooks.C_SchedulerHook.hook(Scheduler)
+        target = object.__new__(Scheduler)
+        state, stats = hooks.StateManager, hooks.request_stats_manager
+        state.reset()
+        stats.reset()
+        self.addCleanup(state.reset)
+        self.addCleanup(stats.reset)
+        with (
+            patch.object(hooks.C_SchedulerHook, "INFERENCE_PREDICTOR", predictor),
+            patch.object(
+                hooks.C_SchedulerHook, "SIM_MODE", hooks.SimulationMode.OFFLINE
+            ),

+            self.assertEqual([r.past_kv_length for r in seen[1].reqs], [4, 4])
+            self.assertAlmostEqual(state.get_global_clock(), 0.04)
